Last 24 hours in world news:

• US President Trump said America will take control of Greenland, even if Greenland doesn’t agree. He says it is needed to stop China or Russia from gaining influence and to protect US security.

• Chinese, Russian, and Iranian warships reached near Cape Town in South Africa for joint naval drills. This comes as tensions rise over US actions in Venezuela and oil tanker seizures.

• Russia said it used its new Oreshnik ballistic missile in a large attack on Ukraine.

• In Minneapolis, US, new phone video surfaced in a fatal police shooting case. The city mayor has asked for full transparency in the investigation.

• In the Philippines, a huge Catholic religious procession saw hundreds of thousands of people. Some also protested against corruption.

• Trump said the US will refine and sell up to 50 million barrels of Venezuelan oil after President Maduro’s removal.

• In Switzerland, a ski resort bar owner was arrested after a fire killed 40 people.

• Iran’s Supreme Leader Khamenei called for unity as mass protests continue across the country.

• US lawmakers demanded more documents in the Jeffrey Epstein case.

• Pakistan is close to a $1.5 billion deal to sell arms and jets to Sudan.

• In South Korea, a court delayed the sentencing of former President Yun Suk-yeol over insurrection charges.

• New footage showed US forces boarding another oil tanker linked to Venezuela sanctions.

• In the Philippines, a landfill collapse killed one person, injured many, and left dozens missing.
